changelog.text:
## What's Changed
* Changelog for v0.69.0-preview.0 by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30222
* Changelog for v0.68.0 by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30224
* chore(release): bump version to 0.70.0-nightly.20261110.g1603e9bab by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30223
* test(cli): remove redundant lowercase restart test in AdminSettingsChangedDialog by @luisfelipe-alt in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30221
* fix(cli): preserve Unicode prompts and strip ANSI fragments in session previews (#29915) by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30220
* fix(cli): preserve selected worktree across authentication restarts (#30078) by @duvanka-prasad in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30176
* fix(core): preserve interrupted placeholder after empty model responses to tool turns by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30228
* fix(cli): apply default in ${VAR:-default} when variable is set but empty by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30250
* fix(core): scale undici bodyTimeout when request timeout exceeds 300s default by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30258
* fix(core,cli): report accurate output token limits in models list by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30253
* fix(cli): restore workspace directories only after resumeChat succeeds by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30259
* fix(core,cli): scope foreground retry status to active main prompt and current model policy by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30266
* fix(cli): initialize auth capabilities and deduplicate options when listing models by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30271
* fix(cli): skip system MCP servers with insecure command permissions by @elberthc-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30283
* refactor(core): use re2js for linear-time policy argsPattern evaluation by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30282
* chore(deps): update workspace dependencies and sandbox runtime packages by @DavidAPierce in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30321
* fix(cli): disclose canonical link path and default consent prompt to no by @jvargassanchez-dot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30289
* fix(cli): detect local git clone from CLI path instead of cwd by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30315
* fix(ide): use per-user discovery directory and atomic port file writes by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30340
* ci: pre-pull triage image and clear Docker login in dedup workflows by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30342
* fix(core): keep ASK_USER for shell commands with unresolved expansion by @luisfelipe-alt in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30338
* fix(core): match commandPrefix and commandRegex rules against the top-level command argument by @luisfelipe-alt in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30355
* chore(deps): adjust workspace dependency pins and update simple-git by @DavidAPierce in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30356


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/compare/v0.69.0...v0.70.0
